strongest_substantive_objection.text: The integrator is described as converting a changing position into its accumulated value. This confuses integration of a velocity/change command into position with integration of position itself.
strongest_substantive_objection.suggestion: The name refers to accumulating eye-velocity commands over time into a position signal.
strongest_substantive_objection.resolution: Actual line55 now correctly says an eye-velocity command is accumulated over time into a position signal.

findings.issue: Integrator description implies integrating position rather than velocity/change command.
findings.required_change: Say movement or eye-velocity commands are accumulated over time into a position signal.
findings.evidence: Major et al. 2004 introduction: tonic firing represents time integral of velocity-encoding saccadic and vestibular inputs.
findings.resolution: Line55 now reads: The name refers to accumulating an eye-velocity command over time into a position signal. Correct integration variable and resulting quantity.

checks.detail: Six eye-rotating extraocular muscles, rectus actions, oblique/vertical contributions and CNIII/IV/VI supply correct. The simplified description does not claim nerve origin and target are always ipsilateral.

Repeated spikes sustaining tension, tonic versus exactly periodic firing and pulse-and-step concept correct. Major Fig1 shows integrator neuron firing, not motoneuron force; Anderson supports prolonged activation/mechanics. A direct classic motoneuron reference would be more specific for pulse-and-step but is not required to correct the explanation.

Elastic restoring torque, viscous damping and no static inertial or purely viscous holding torque are correct. Dominance of elasticity/viscosity in primate plant is supported by Anderson introduction.

Linear small-angle approximation clearly labeled. I*phi_ddot+B*phi_dot+K*phi=tau_m has consistent torque units. Static tau_m=K*phi and fixed-torque stiffness comparison correct. Neglecting inertia after torque removal gives phi=phi0*exp(-t*K/B),tau_p=B/K. Model limitations and multiple actual relaxation times acknowledged.

Reversible disruption, horizontal gaze time constant about0.2s compared with intact>20s in darkness match Cannon and Robinson1987 abstract. Time constant means exponential decay rate, not total return time.

Visual/vestibular roles, darkness persistence and longer-timescale plasticity distinct from immediate tissue dynamics correctly separated. Major goldfish training/reversal and timescale supported; cellular mechanism appropriately unresolved.
Coherent pattern versus correct stored coordinate and ideal attractor distinction correctly framed as a circuit/model claim, with neutral along-family dynamics.

Specific continuous-attractor source remains identified as proposed mechanism. OMN versus internuclear cells, abducens/lateral rectus anatomy and response-based identification match Ben-Shushan2022 Methods and ExtendedDataFig6. Ocular plant definition useful and correct.

Orbit, extraocular muscles, OMNs, torque, tonic firing, saccade, elasticity, viscosity, inertia, integrator, plasticity and abducens nucleus defined sufficiently. Dot notation explained by velocity/acceleration sentence. Source language eye-plant model precedes plant definition in later chapter but is intelligible from context; later wording review can judge.
